name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: A robot that reads why your automated software build broke, figures out the cause, and writes a fix for you to approve, instead of you digging through logs for an hour.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small or mid-size startup losing developer hours to flaky CI failures who has no dedicated DevOps or SRE person.
business_use_cases: A DevOps consultant offers a managed 'CI triage' service for startups that can't afford a full-time SRE.
An agency deploys it self-hosted with a client's own models for a security-conscious company that can't send code to third parties.
A consultant builds a reporting dashboard on top showing leadership how much engineering time was saved on CI triage.

money_ideas.idea: A subscription hosted or managed CI-triage service billed monthly per team
One-off setup and integration consulting for self-hosted deployments

steal_this: Offer one startup a free trial week of CI triage, then convert it into a paid monthly retainer.
